subject: ddl: allow dropping CHECK constraints when tidb_enable_check_constraint is OFF (#65243)
summary: Change is narrowly scoped: removes the `tidb_enable_check_constraint` guard for `ast.AlterTableDropCheck`, so `ALTER TABLE ... DROP CHECK|CONSTRAINT` always schedules `ActionDropCheckConstraint` (metadata removal) even when the feature flag is OFF. Checked the drop path (`executor.DropCheckConstraint` -> `onDropCheckConstraint`) and its state transitions; no Blocker/High correctness, consistency, concurrency, or metadata/state-machine issues found in this commit diff.
